summary: The scoped mid-red gate follows D2 to D7. Both test files pass at HEAD. I reproduced the Monorepo range evidence exactly on the read-only clone. The docs match the code. No bypass exists beyond the accepted F1 claim limit. I found four nonblocking points: two D3 clauses have no test, the folder check reads the working tree, the contracts bullet omits two D5 failure rules, and AC-9 is still open.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] review-a: No test covers the all() rule of D3 or the measure/archive/ folder. Replace all() with any() in red_scope, or remove archive from is_track_folder, and all 11 tests still pass. A wrong any() rule would skip a production commit that carries one real track id and one unknown id. The code at HEAD is correct; the test file is shallow on these two points.

F2 [Nit] review-a: is_track_folder reads the working tree at HEAD, not the tree of the commit. One commit can add measure/tracks/<new-id>/ and tag its production change (track_id: <new-id>); the gate then skips that commit. I built this fixture and saw the skip. The INFO line stays visible, so this is a variant of the accepted claim limit.

F3 [Nit] review-a: The 'Track scope (Mid Red)' bullet of contracts.md omits two D5 rules: the 'mid-red could not list the files of commit' failure and the old-file-set fallback when git log fails. FR-6 does not require these rules, but this section is the operator contract.

F4 [Nit] review-a: AC-9 has no result. Task 3.3 is [~], and green-p3-full-suite.log stops at '--- suite: test_s3_adversarial.sh ---' with no suite result and no total. The plan makes no AC-9 claim, so no false claim exists. The review-a role gate returns FAIL with 'current phase still has 1 non-deferred incomplete tasks' until Task 3.3 becomes [x]. Do not record the phase as suite-verified until the run ends with PASS.
evidence: audited diff 232bc29..b09dd9c adds commit_track_ids, is_track_folder, RedScope, red_scope, commit_paths, non_test_paths, and the scoped mid-red branch of cmd_role_gate.
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/spec_review_gate -p test_red_track_scope.py gives 'Ran 11 tests ... OK'. This matches the Task 3.1 plan claim.
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/spec_review_gate -p test_checker.py gives 'Ran 38 tests ... OK'. This matches the Task 3.1 plan claim, and it covers the unchanged single-track output of D4.

A probe repo shows git log -z --format=%H%n%B gives one record per commit (7 records for 7 commits). The subject tag form reads two ids in order, the body line form reads one id, a subject of 'track_id: login' reads no id, and '(track_id: LOGIN)' reads an id that names no folder, so that commit counts as own (fail closed).

The probe shows diff-tree -r --root --cc --no-renames --name-only on a merge lists the conflict file and the merge-only file, and hides a path that the merge takes unchanged from a parent. This matches D5.

I ran the checker at HEAD on /tmp/monoclone for range 08e60c795..126189088. It printed the same 12 INFO lines and 'PASS: mid-red gate passed' as measure/runs/red_gate_track_scope_20261108/green-p3-monorepo-look-range.log. That range has 20 commits.

The diff of contracts.md names the mid-red exception in the Baseline and HEAD advance bullets. The new Track scope bullet matches D2, D3, D4, D5, and D7. CHANGELOG.md and measure/tech-debt.md record the change and the D8 follow-up row.

The tests fail for these wrong implementations: a full committed-file set (AC-2), a plain diff-tree on a merge (AC-7), per-parent or -m output (AC-7), rename detection on (AC-6), a scan of all message lines for the tag form (AC-4), a weak key case (AC-4), a scope built with no skipped commit (AC-8), and oldest-first INFO lines (AC-1).

No vacuous-pass (A4) check is added: a missing commit or a missing folder makes a commit own, so the gate fails closed. No digit-only count (A3) assertion exists; every count assertion uses a labeled string. The plan makes no 'all checks pass' or PASS=N claim (A5), and AC-9 is honestly [~].

`audit-result --role review-a` reports PASS for this result file. `role-gate --role review-a` returns FAIL with only 'current phase still has 1 non-deferred incomplete tasks', because phase_counts counts a [~] task as incomplete. No source finding comes from that FAIL.
